result.summary: Backend: scripts/test_parallel.sh (16 partitions) combined 4196 tests, 6 properties, 7 failures (4195/4202 passed); partition 8 crashed with no Result: line (environmental, ISS-0264-class, mid-run on an unrelated test module). Targeted serial re-run of the 3 REQ-378-relevant files: 14/16 passed, 2 failed, deterministic. Root cause: auth_pipeline.ex's new verify_local_account_state/2 step now sources conn.assigns.auth_context.roles from Identity.list_effective_role_names/2 (a live group_members/tenant_role DB query) instead of identity_context.roles (the OIDC token's own claims), so any JIT-provisioned user whose role exists only as a token claim (no group_members row yet) gets roles: [] instead of the claimed role. This breaks 3 tests: test/letflow/plugs/auth_pipeline_test.exs:158 (AC1), test/letflow/plugs/api_pipeline_integration_test.exs:105 (REQ-071 AC2), test/letflow/routers/req077_promotion_pipeline_test.exs:1034 (design section 12.9) -- all confirmed CAUSED BY THIS BRANCH via git diff (auth_pipeline.ex/identity.ex are the only changed files these tests exercise) plus deterministic reproduction. The new REQ-378 test file (test/letflow/plugs/iss0736_oidc_live_revocation_test.exs) itself shows 0 failures, satisfying that specific acceptance criterion. Two other failure clusters (Letflow.SecretsRuntimeConfigTest 60s subprocess-boot timeout in partition 2; Letflow.TenantSchemaReaperTest x3 ISS-0110 concurrent-invocation-guard defers in partition 10) are attributed pre-existing/environmental per the structural test in core-directives.md: neither file nor its dependencies appear in git diff origin/main...HEAD, and TenantSchemaReaperTest's failure mode is its own documented deliberate concurrent-invocation guard (ISS-0110/ISS-0217 already on main). Frontend: npm test in web/ -- 106 test files, 728 tests, 0 failures, including the new web/src/api/__tests__/identity.removeMembers.test.ts (2/2 passed).
